data.one_liner: A state management and dependency injection library for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides state management and dependency injection inspired by Riverpod and async_redux. It adds Flutter integration to the core Refena library, helping manage app state and rebuild widgets when it changes.
use_when: You want a state management solution inspired by Riverpod and async_redux
You need to manage application state and dependency injection in Flutter
avoid_when: You prefer to use established alternatives like Provider, Riverpod, or Bloc
strengths: Combines state management and dependency injection
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Smaller ecosystem and community compared to major alternatives like Riverpod or Bloc
Documentation relies on external references for core changes
data.setup_notes: Add refena_flutter to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: A more widely adopted state management library with a large ecosystem and community.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Predictable state management using the BLoC pattern with extensive tooling and testing support.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: A simpler, officially recommended inherited widget wrapper for basic dependency injection and state management.
